title: Canned beans and chicken
ingredients: Rinse different types of beans, cook them with salt and spices
A Three-Bean Chili or a Mediterranean Bean Ragout are your best bets. Both are high-fiber, low-fat, and pair perfectly with a plain grilled or seared chicken breast.
The Mediterranean Ragout is particularly good for cholesterol because it uses heart-healthy olive oil and aromatics instead of heavy animal fats.
Serves 4 | Prep time: 5 mins | Cook time: 15 mins
The Beans (Use 1 can of each, drained and rinsed):
Red Kidney Beans: High in antioxidants and holds shape well.
1 can (14oz) Crushed Tomatoes or Fire-Roasted Diced Tomatoes
1 tsp Dried Oregano & 1/2 tsp Smoked Paprika (adds a "meaty" flavor without the meat)
Fresh Spinach or Kale (optional, stir in at the end for extra micros)
instructions: 1. Sauté: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; cook until soft (about 5 minutes).
2. Simmer: Stir in the tomatoes, oregano, and paprika. Let it bubble for 2–3 minutes.
3. Combine: Add all your rinsed beans. Stir well and simmer for 10 minutes so the beans soak up the flavor.
4. Finish: Stir in your greens until wilted. Season with a pinch of salt and plenty of black pepper.
How to pair it with Chicken:

To keep the nutrition balanced, slice your 100g cooked chicken breast and lay it right on top of a large bowl of the beans. The sauce from the beans acts as a "gravy" for the lean chicken, keeping it from tasting dry.
